channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jason Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jason Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rick Adelman on Brad Miller, Peja Stojakovic, Jason Williams, Mike Bibby, Bobby Jackson, Doug Christie
item.description:
Jason Anderson:Rick Adelman:

“We had Vlade. We had Chris. Players like Peja Stojakovic, who’s here today; Mike Bibby; Doug Christie, who’s here today; Bobby Jackson, who’s here today; Brad Miller. We also had Jason Williams, who’s here today. What a great group.”

Rick Adelman on Brad Miller, Peja Stojakovic, Jason Williams, Mike Bibby, Bobby Jackson, Doug Christie, Sep 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Mike Bibby on Jason Williams
item.description:
“I got there and Jason Williams was a prized possession in Sacramento and when I got traded for him, I just wanted to fit in, I didn’t know if the fans would like me or if the team would like me. In my first year we had the best record in the West. I had the best time of my life and my career playing in Sacramento with those guys. I think Sacramento is the best team I played on.”

Mike Bibby on Jason Williams, May 25, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Mike Bibby on Jason Williams
item.description:
In a recent interview with CBS Local’s DJ Sixsmith, Bibby reflected back on his time with the Kings.

“The guys treated me like I was there for five, six, seven years. I got there and Jason Williams was a prized possession in Sacramento and when I got traded for him, I just wanted to fit in, I didn’t know if the fans would like me or if the team would like me. In my first year we had the best record in the West. I had the best time of my life and my career playing in Sacramento with those guys. I think Sacramento is the best team I played on.”

Mike Bibby on Jason Williams, May 18, 2020. Source: Sactown Royalty.

item.title: Sergio Rodriguez on Allen Iverson, Jason Williams
item.description:
“Allen Iverson is one of my idols. I scored 23 points against him. It was a dream playing against him, he was like Jason Williams, he had a unique playing style that you enjoyed watching,”

Sergio Rodriguez on Allen Iverson, Jason Williams, May 4, 2020. Source: TalkBasket.
